summary: Keystone Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its units may elect to separate them into Class A ordinary shares and warrants, with separate trading commencing on or about June 22, 2026. Each unit comprises one ordinary share and one-half warrant. The units, shares, and warrants will trade on Nasdaq under symbols KEYYU, KEYY, and KEYYW, respectively. No fractional warrants will be issued. Holders must contact the transfer agent to separate units. This is a routine post-IPO administrative event, not a special situation.
